description: Conformant variants for the advanced test-writing exercise. Each variant changes one part of a :core source file without changing the result required by the contract. Run ./gradlew generateVariants to create modules using the original :core with one file replaced, then ./gradlew verifyVariants to test each variant with your suite. Tests that check only the contract should pass for every variant. If a test fails, the report marks it as a false alarm and shows which tests may need to be relaxed. Variants have no individual descriptions on purpose: explaining what each one changes would give away which tests to reconsider. Only the advanced-tier contract addendum determines whether a variant is allowed. Search patterns include the full `override` line because the KDoc above it contains the same expression.
